RIN_RULES.name: Pitru Rin
RIN_RULES.label: Ancestral/Father Debt
RIN_RULES.indication: Loss of wealth, career blocks, friction with authority/father figures, hard work not paying off
RIN_RULES.remedy: Collect money/food from relatives and donate to a temple, on the same day

RIN_RULES.name: Matru Rin
RIN_RULES.label: Mother Debt
RIN_RULES.indication: Mother's health issues, domestic instability, financial losses
RIN_RULES.remedy: Offer silver coins or a silver item, collected from relatives, into a flowing river

RIN_RULES.name: Stri Rin
RIN_RULES.label: Debt to Women/Wife
RIN_RULES.indication: Marital turbulence, difficulty finding/keeping a partner, recurring conflict with women in the family
RIN_RULES.remedy: Respect and serve the women in one's family; avoid disrespecting women; donate white items on Mondays
